overview_description.description: Matjrah is a Saudi platform that brings together and provides all the needs of an online store in one place, with easy steps and a simple user experience. It offers a convenient and streamlined solution for businesses looking to establish or expand their online presence. businesses aims to simplify the process of running an e-commerce store by offering a comprehensive range of features and services in a user-friendly manner. Whether it's managing inventory, processing orders, or engaging with customers, Matajera provides a seamless platform that allows businesses to focus on their core operations while maximizing their online potential. With its user-friendly interface and intuitive design, businesses ensures that even those with limited technical knowledge can easily navigate and utilize its features. By consolidating all the essential elements of an online store into one platform, businesses simplifies the e-commerce journey, empowering businesses to establish and thrive in the digital marketplace.

product.name: Unified Retail Management Platform
product.description: A platform that manages all sales channels including website, mobile app, and POS from a single dashboard for unified retail operations.

product.name: Customizable Online Store Builder
product.description: A tool to create fully customizable online stores without preset templates, allowing control over design and user experience.

product.name: Product and Inventory Management System
product.description: A system for managing unlimited products and inventory with support for retail, wholesale, variations, and real-time synchronization across channels.

product.name: Integrated Point of Sale (POS) System
product.description: A POS system fully integrated with the online store and operational apps, enabling synchronized sales and inventory management.

product.name: Payment Gateway Integration
product.description: Direct integration with multiple payment gateways including Mada, STC Pay, and Gulf banks, without monthly fees (commercial license required).

product.name: Shipping Integration
product.description: Integration with leading local and Gulf shipping companies, offering flexible pricing and delivery options.
